violation_type.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation no longer has  a fenced outdoor area.

finding_variants.text: The operation no longer has  a fenced outdoor area.

The operation did not ensure that the outdoor activity area was enclosed by a fence at least four feet in height. During the inspection, one section of the fence measured approximately three feet high.
There is not a fenced outdoor activity space.
The chain linked fence has sections of the fence removed, which prevents it from being fully enclosed.
The operation used the temporary area as a playground, and the temporary area did not have a fence around it.
The operation has not yet completed their fenced outdoor space.
